payload.reason: The evidence provides specific competitive results obtained on various datasets, indicating the performance of the models tested.

claims.text: Competitive results were reported on the Wall Street Journal and Hub5'00 conversational evaluation datasets.
Competitive results were also shown on the 2000hr Fisher+Switchboard dataset.
The architecture achieved state-of-the-art results on LibriSpeech and competitive results on other benchmarks.
SOTA performance was achieved on the test-clean subset and among end-to-end models on test-other for LibriSpeech.
